title: AML / Reporting Thresholds

sections.heading: 3 STAGES OF MONEY LAUNDERING (P-L-I)
items: 1. PLACEMENT — dirty cash enters system (MOST detectable stage)
2. LAYERING — series of transactions to disguise origin/ownership
3. INTEGRATION — funds re-emerge as 'legitimate' income

sections.heading: CTR DETAILS
items: Triggered by CURRENCY only (cash) — NOT checks, NOT wires
More than $10,000 in ONE DAY (aggregate, single customer)
Filed with FinCEN (bureau of U.S. Treasury, NOT DOJ)
Penalty: up to $500,000 fine, 10 yrs prison, or both
Structuring = breaking deposits to dodge $10K = ILLEGAL (e.g., 25 × $500)

sections.heading: SAR DETAILS
items: $5,000+ if suspect: illegal funds, BSA evasion, no business purpose, or facilitating crime
NO minimum for suspected terrorist financing
30 days from awareness to file with FinCEN
CONFIDENTIAL — do NOT tell customer; if subpoenaed, refuse & notify FinCEN
Filing is at firm's discretion based on suspicion — no certainty needed

sections.heading: OFAC / SDN LIST
items: Office of Foreign Assets Control = Treasury Dept
SDN = Specially Designated Nationals (terrorists, drug traffickers, sanctioned parties)
Must screen ALL new customers against SDN list BEFORE opening account
If match: BLOCK assets, refuse business, recheck periodically
Required under USA PATRIOT Act / CIP rules

sections.heading: RED FLAGS → REPORT TO AML OFFICER
items: Indifference to risk, commissions, or costs
Frequent/large cash deposits or wire transfers to unrelated 3rd parties
Excessive journal entries between unrelated accounts
Structuring — designing deposits/withdrawals under $10K
Pattern of small recurring deposits (e.g., $1,000/wk for many weeks)

items.Role: Treasury bureau — collects CTRs/SARs (intel, no enforcement)

sections.heading: FINRA RULE 3220 — GIFTS
items: Max $100 per person per year to employees of other firms
Applies to non-cash gifts given/received in connection with business
Promotional items <$50 with firm logo typically excluded
Personal gifts (weddings, etc.) generally exempt if not business-related
Bereavement gifts exempt

common_traps: CTR = CASH ONLY. Checks and wire transfers do NOT trigger a CTR even if over $10K.
CTR is >$10,000 in 15 days to file; SAR is $5,000+ in 30 days to file. Don't swap the numbers/days.
SAR for suspected terrorist financing has NO dollar minimum.
FinCEN and OFAC are both TREASURY (not DOJ, not SEC). FinCEN has no enforcement arm.
Possession of inside info / suspicious behavior is reported — but SAR filing must NEVER be disclosed to the customer.
Structuring is illegal even if the underlying money is clean — the act of evasion itself is the crime.
